remarks: Location location location! Winter Rental Furnished. This home is conveniently located in the very popular Imperial Avenue neighborhood. Walk to downtown, train station, close to many amenities, including the beach, Long Shore Golf Club Park, restaurants, shopping, Westport's award winning Public Library, and the vibrant downtown Saugatuck area. This home includes Living Room (with fireplace), Family Room, Dining Room, 2 Bedrooms (one currently set up as an office - will fit a bed) and one Full Bath. Family Room walks out to the patio with pergola and a beautiful level private back yard. Rent includes heat & hot water, electricity, snow removal, & lawn care. Off street parking room for 2 cars. Private laundry in basement. No pets. Lease required.
